scientific_scope: Persistent research reporting, evidence snapshots, manuscript versioning, claim-evidence traceability, citation provenance and reproducibility export.

methods.name: Frozen report-evidence snapshot
methods.implementation: Persisted Field/Trial/Twin/Model evidence tables are hashed as deterministic CSV and stored as reporting snapshot artifacts.
methods.limitations: A hash proves content identity, not scientific validity or completeness.

methods.name: Claim-evidence ledger
methods.implementation: Manuscript claims can be linked to evidence type, source record and effect/statistic with automated high-risk wording checks.
methods.limitations: The wording audit is rule-based and cannot determine whether a causal/statistical interpretation is substantively correct.

methods.name: Evidence-derived methods inventory
methods.implementation: Method candidates are inferred from persisted weather, EO, Twin, experiment, validation and model artifacts; researchers approve the final method list.
methods.limitations: Inference cannot replace manual verification of the exact analysis configuration.

methods.name: Privacy-aware research export
methods.implementation: Public-package mode can redact identified coordinate, field, genotype and researcher columns and records the applied redaction rules.
methods.limitations: Automated redaction is not a guarantee of complete de-identification of free text or uncommon identifiers.

integrity_rules: Do not generate manuscript numerical claims from evidence that is not present in the frozen/current artifact set.
Do not treat predictive or mechanistic evidence as causal evidence.
Do not call a report reproducible without recording the evidence snapshot/model/dataset provenance used.
Do not silently overwrite submitted/final report versions.
Do not fabricate citations or journal requirements.
AI-assisted reporting must remain author-reviewed and may not invent measurements, significance or references.
